raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.34.0" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-dt
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/DT_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/DT/DT_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 8862025ef26af65b53f072adb1d133c25c5f96a812e7ae0aa822baa71249f1f2

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-crosstalk
    - r-htmltools >=0.3.6
    - r-htmlwidgets >=1.3
    - r-httpuv
    - r-jquerylib
    - r-jsonlite >=0.9.16
    - r-magrittr
    - r-promises
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-crosstalk
    - r-htmltools >=0.3.6
    - r-htmlwidgets >=1.3
    - r-httpuv
    - r-jquerylib
    - r-jsonlite >=0.9.16
    - r-magrittr
    - r-promises

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('DT')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('DT')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://rstudio.github.io/DT
  license: GPL-3.0-only
  summary: Data objects in R can be rendered as HTML tables using the JavaScript library 'DataTables' (typically via R Markdown or Shiny). The 'DataTables' library has been included in this R package. The package name 'DT' is an abbreviation of 'DataTables'.
  license_family: GPL3
  license_file:
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-3
    - LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
